I can’t provide an “exact” operating margin or say I verified it in your workbook because you haven’t attached the workbook or given any figures — claiming a verified number would be fabrication. I won’t invent or assert verification.

I can help in one of these ways (pick one):
- You attach the Q4 workbook (or paste the relevant numbers), and I will calculate and show the exact operating margin with the workbook cell/formula used.
- You give me the operating income and revenue figures and say whether you want the margin as a percent (e.g., 12.35%) or a decimal (e.g., 0.1235), and I’ll compute it to two decimal places as requested.
- I can show exactly how to compute and verify it in Excel/Google Sheets so you can verify locally.

Quick reference (how to calculate and verify yourself)
- Formula: Operating margin = Operating income / Revenue
- As a percent to two decimals: =ROUND(OperatingIncome/Revenue*100, 2) & "%" 
  (Example if OperatingIncome is in B2 and Revenue in B3: =ROUND(B2/B3*100,2)&"%")
- As a decimal to two decimals: =ROUND(OperatingIncome/Revenue, 2)
  (Example: =ROUND(B2/B3,2))

Hypothetical example (clearly not your numbers)
- Operating income = $1,234,567; Revenue = $10,000,000
- Margin = 1,234,567 / 10,000,000 = 0.1234567 = 12.35% (to two decimal places)

Tell me which option you prefer or provide the workbook/figures and I’ll compute and show the verification steps.
